name: email-send
description: Send a new email. Provide comma-separated recipient email addresses, subject, and body. Emails are sent from the agent's configured email address.

inputs.subject: string
inputs.reply_to_message_id: string? (Nylas message ID — when set, the original message is quoted below the reply and the send is threaded)
inputs.context_bridge: string? (JSON — optional context bridge registration: {agent_id, expected_reply?, delegation_hint?, metadata?, expires_in_hours?})
